data.name: Mutation
data.detailed_description:
Driven by the hardships of life, the protagonist takes a job as a waiter at the remote Xiqi Manor. During a busy dinner banquet, he sneaks away to the storage room, gets drunk, and falls into a deep sleep. Unexpectedly, he becomes entangled in a massive conspiracy within his dreams.

When he wakes up, he finds that everything has changed. The entire manor is now filled with nothing but walking dead. As the likely sole survivor, he must escape this isolated manor of death and uncover the colossal secret hidden behind it all.

This will be the most thrilling night of his life.

This is a survival horror game with limited resources, featuring relatively simple puzzle-solving mechanics that directly drive the game's progression.

The game is played from a first-person perspective with a fixed FOV (Field of View). Players prone to 3D motion sickness are advised to purchase with caution.

This title was developed by a single indie developer. Due to limited production resources, there may be some imperfections. We appreciate your understanding and support!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 3200G / Intel Core i3-9100F
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX580 with 8GB VRAM / NVIDIA GeForce GTX1060 With 6GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 16 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: With graphics settings on low, the game runs at 1080p/45fps.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit) / Windows 11 (64bit)/
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600 / Intel Core i5 12400F
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 6700XT / NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 16 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: With graphics settings maxed out, the game runs at 1080p/60fps.

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content
